d: Relive the highlights of an eight-goal thriller as Tajikistan defeat Cuba 5-3 in Group F of the FIFA U-17 World Cup 2026, powered by Komiljon Sharipov, Parviz Bobonazarov, Bikhishti Radzhabzod, and an Asadbek Makhtumov brace that outlasted Yojanny Gonzalez's double and Yankarlos Iglesias's strike.
